chapter: Brass bands and coming to New Orleans
title: Country band and funerals on the plantation
summary: Before New Orleans he played sheet music in a country plantation band of sixteen, with funerals and a society called Morning Light.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, what kind of music did you used to play before you came to New Orleans? This may be going over something you talked to him about before, but I'd like to know.
What kind of music? What you mean, uh, horn? What kind of horn did you play?
No, I mean, what type of music? Were people playing the same jazz type of music other places?

The same kind of music. Sheet music. You know what I mean? But, uh, which was then, uh, the gym, I don't think. I remember it. He used to come down there and teach the band. The place is a granddaddy.
Now, out there in the country, did that band play funerals and parades?
Yeah, the band could play anything any other band. And that's why when I came there, I know it, much easier, it's under no noise. Because I learned in the country.
So you'd sort of just grown up playing, huh? That's right, yeah.
Did they have dirges out in the country? Yeah. Would they have funerals with a band of music?
Well, they'd have funerals, sometimes. But it wasn't often like this, you understand me, because they didn't get many people down that way.
Then you had more musicians down there than you had up here in proportion of the population. They died every season.
We had, uh, in our band, we had 16.
And that was a small place, wasn't it?
Yeah, yeah. It was a plantation, or 10.

How many people on the plantation would you say about? About two, three hundred. That's quite a large portion of them playing music, to add that up. So, uh, would the funerals down there be a little like the funerals up here, or a little bit different, or a lot different of them?

Well, you see, they didn't have the road to go down there that they have here, you see? But they died every day, and if they leave the church, they may go back to the cemetery, and come right on back. They couldn't make no wrong, but they had to make a decision.
Would they be supported by an organization down there, society?
Yes, we had a society called The Morning Light.
The Morning Light, huh? That's right. Were there any other societies?
